title: Ἠθικὴ στοιχείωσις — Hierocles, Elements of Ethics (P.Berol. 9780) with the Stobaean excerpts On Duties; RU «Основы этики»
author: Hierocles the Stoic
size: About 11 papyrus columns plus about 15 Stobaean excerpts; est. 9–10k words
edition: von Arnim, BKT IV (1906), public domain: https://archive.org/details/coo.31924022696045. Bastianini and Long, CPF (1992), copyrighted.
ru_evidence: ruwiki Гиерокл (стоик) lists no translation. CyberLeninka ('Гиерокл Элементы этики', 'ойкейосис') finds none, and neither do the ΣΧΟΛΗ issues.
en_evidence: I. Ramelli (trans. D. Konstan), Hierocles the Stoic: Elements of Ethics, Fragments and Excerpts (SBL/Brill 2009), per Open Library.
other_translations: Italian in CPF I.1** (Bastianini and Long 1992), not verified in this sweep.
value: The main Imperial-age Stoic source on oikeiosis and self-perception. Contains the famous 'concentric circles' of concern and household ethics (marriage, parents, kin). Widely taught in courses on Stoicism and cosmopolitanism.
ai_feasibility: High for the Stobaeus excerpts; medium for the papyrus, which has lacunae and supplements. Small and manageable.
pilot_unit: Entire corpus, about 10k words. Mini-pilot: the 'circles' excerpt (Stobaeus IV.27.23), under 1k words.
